lines.cap: Never run from a dog. Here's why.
lines.say: Never run from a dog. Here's why.

lines.cap: Running tells a dog's brain one thing. Chase. It's instinct, even in friendly dogs.
lines.say: Running tells a dog's brain one thing. Chase. It's instinct, even in friendly dogs.

lines.cap: And you won't win. Most dogs can sprint faster than most people.
lines.say: And you won't win. Most dogs can sprint faster than most people.

lines.cap: Instead, be a tree. Stop. Stand still. Arms in.
lines.say: Instead, be a tree. Stop. Stand still. Arms in.

lines.cap: Don't stare into its eyes. To a dog, that's a challenge. Look slightly away.
lines.say: Don't stare into its eyes. To a dog, that's a challenge. Look slightly away.

lines.cap: Turn a little side-on, and speak calmly. Then back away, slowly.
lines.say: Turn a little side-on, and speak calmly. Then back away, slowly.

lines.cap: Most dogs lose interest in something that isn't moving.
lines.say: Most dogs lose interest in something that isn't moving.

lines.cap: And if you're ever knocked down, curl into a ball, and cover your neck with your hands.
lines.say: And if you're ever knocked down, curl into a ball, and cover your neck with your hands.

lines.cap: Save this. Then send it to someone who jogs.
lines.say: Save this. Then send it to someone who jogs.
